item.tib: khro bo mchog lnga don gyis bsgrubs
item.coloph: li shu'i (shus) lho brag khom mthing du sbas/ rgyal mo gsum gyis lung bstan nas/ bzhod ston dngos grub grag gis ston (grags pas bton) no/ mkhan slob rnams (rnam) gnyis kyis (kyi) drung nas zhus so// (bya sa 'bum khri'i 'od la) dngos grub du bab/ de nas rim par brgyud nas/ drin chen
